The '''Toydarian palace''' was a large palace located on the [[Toydarian/Legends|Toydarian]] [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Toydaria/Legends|Toydaria]] [[21 BBY/Legends|during]] the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], and was only accessible through flight. It was the personal residence of [[King/Legends|King]] [[Katuunko/Legends|Katuunko]].

[[Savage Opress/Legends|Savage Opress]] eventually broke into the palace and slayed Katuunko's guards before confronting Katuunko himself.
